description: This file defines the AppRouter class responsible for setting up the application's routing configuration using the go_router package. It specifies the routes for the splash screen, lobby screen, and online match screen, including route parameters and associated screen widgets.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to build and configure the application's route map using go_router.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured GoRouter instance with defined routes and route parameters.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates the application's routing configuration with initial route and route definitions.
